_about: Public goldens: Logic's own saves of a blank project, one change per save, tracked under tests/corpus/. Paths are relative to that directory. Facts are what tests may assert. strips/ holds channel strips `logic strip-save` exported from those saves, laid out as config/example-chains.json names them.
